parameters: Okay, Mila wasn't kidding about this place
being 'sunken'. Half the desert poured in
here! So much for keeping my boots clean...
Don't let the wide open space fool you. A room
this big means enemies can circle us easily.
Keep an eye on those shifting sand piles...
beasts love to ambush from below.
He is right. The corruption from the anchor is
incredibly thick in here... I can feel it
Then we shouldn't stick around to see what
wakes up. Let's stay close, watch our flanks,
and push through to the other side.
The Pharaoh's Guard is waiting for us. Let's
"Navigate the depths of the Sunken Tomb."
You have unlocked the Sunken Tomb Waypoint Crystal.
